name: Adani Enterprises
narrative: Revenue grew 75.1% year-on-year to ₹37,216 crore in Q2 FY27, reflecting operational expansion. However, net profit fell 64.2% to ₹1,221 crore, demonstrating margin compression despite management's focus on unlocking segmental EBITDA across new incubating businesses.

promises.statement: Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway are expected to add over INR 3,000 crores EBITDA in FY27.

said.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL

promises.statement: Company expects FY27 capital expenditure to be around INR 40,000 crores.

said.quote: We expect the next year to be around the same level, about INR40,000 crores

promises.statement: Capex for the airports segment is expected to be roughly INR 17,000 crores in FY27.

said.quote: And of that, there are 3 core areas where the capex is, especially airports, which will be roughly, give or take, about INR17,000 crores

promises.statement: Mining Services dispatch volume is expected to grow by around 20% in FY27.

said.quote: You can expect that we will be high double-digit growth next year as well. So say close to 20% mark

promises.metric: New solar cell and module lines operationalization
promises.statement: New 6 GW solar cell and module lines are expected to be ready by September 30, 2026.

said.quote: The new lines would be expected to be ready by 30th September this year

promises.statement: Target total capex for FY26 is roughly INR 36,000 crores.

said.quote: So our total target that we had outlined was roughly INR36,000 crores, and we have already done just about INR25,200 crores
